name: Builtin Cluster: Intraday Returns Variants
description: Tests: intraday_returns(return_type=simple/log/cumulative/directional/monetary). All 5 intraday return type variants on 5-minute bars.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BUILTIN CLUSTER: Intraday Returns Variants
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
open_p = src.o
close = src.c

# === INTRADAY RETURNS: all 5 return types (needs o + c inputs) ===
ir_simple = intraday_returns(return_type=ReturnsType.simple)(open_p, close)
ir_log = intraday_returns(return_type=ReturnsType.log)(open_p, close)
ir_cum = intraday_returns(return_type=ReturnsType.cumulative)(open_p, close)
ir_dir = intraday_returns(return_type=ReturnsType.directional)(open_p, close)
ir_mon = intraday_returns(return_type=ReturnsType.monetary)(open_p, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Intraday Returns: Simple vs Log',
    category='Intraday',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Simple', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Log', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ir_simple, ir_log))

xy_lines(
    title='Intraday Returns: Cumulative',
    category='Intraday',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cumulative', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ir_cum)

xy_lines(
    title='Intraday Returns: Directional vs Monetary',
    category='Intraday',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Directional', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Monetary', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ir_dir, ir_mon))
